title: External artifact refresh after native top4 rejection
method: Metadata-only Hugging Face API checks with ?blobs=true; no model download performed.

repos_checked.decision: Still the main 4Expert/Q4_K candidate, but full download requires >=180GB free disk. Sidecar bypass was rejected separately.
Similar size to current native GGUF; no hard-bound reason to beat accepted route without a new representation or routing change.
All files far exceed available disk. Existing alternate-GGUF hard-bound already rejected smaller 50-65GB candidates for the 10 tok/s objective, so these do not justify a source patch or download now.
Already represented in prior alternate-GGUF screening; still requires large disk and has no new bound over 10 tok/s.
Prior screening already included teamblobfish low-bit candidates; no correctness evidence and no 10 tok/s hard-bound on current 32GB GPU.
Still not current vendor-loadable. DFlash/DSpark verifier routes remain closed by target-verifier and source-read hard bounds unless a new vendor-compatible artifact appears.

decision.reason: No newly checked artifact is both vendor-loadable under current disk constraints and hard-bound above 10 tok/s. The only plausible 4Expert candidate still requires full-disk availability or a new split-loader design; sidecar-only and native top-k shortcuts failed.
next_reopen_conditions: Free or attach >=180GB disk and test cloudyu 4Expert GGUF with existing Q4_K/tid2eid gates.
Find a concrete vendor-loadable artifact with a hard-bound over 10 tok/s on 32GB VRAM and strict 16GB host/page-cache.
Provide a new split-loader hard-bound design before any source patch.
